info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Regulatory Reporting Submissions API
info.description: The Regulatory Reporting Submissions API facilitates the submission of compliance-related documents and data to meet regulatory requirements in the banking sector. This endpoint allows financial institutions to upload their submissions, ensuring they remain in good standing with governing bodies. Key use cases include preparing for audits, tracking submission statuses, and maintaining compliance workflows. It is typically utilized by compliance officers and financial analysts seeking to streamline their reporting processes.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new regulatory submission in the compliance system. Make sure to provide all required fields in the request body to successfully create the submission.
